field.label: Add addresses from the neighbor table
field.help: While host discovery is on, each MAC alias also gets the IPv6 addresses the neighbor table of the firewall has for its MACs and host discovery does not list. An address joins its alias within about 90 seconds and stays up to 12 hours after it left the neighbor table. An alias never holds more than 32 such addresses for one MAC, and all aliases together 1024. Without this, the addresses are removed from the aliases within about a minute.
